# Lending Policy Update and Risk Assessment

This document details critical tasks and investigations required for the Credit & Loans department:

*   Investigate the collateral value standard update.
*   Update the interest rates for strategy 2026.
*   Investigate the default risk quarterly.
*   Optimize the borrower credit score based on audit.
*   Investigate the interest rates quarterly.
